dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Gradual and symmetrical narrowing of the 2D footprint from the widest mid-section toward the posterior peduncle.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: Largely smooth lateral margins with a subtle asymmetrical expansion on the left-hand margin relative to the more linear right-hand margin.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Medium-to-light grey dorsal tone, indicating a sub-adult pigmentation phase; significant specular highlight at the anterior-most point.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.mottling_density_and_topology: Low frequency of localized dark clusters, with darker pixels manifesting primarily as elongated linear streaks rather than patches.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Diffuse gradients throughout the dorsal surface with no sharp demarcations between varying shades of grey.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: Multiple dark, parallel linear marks (rake marks) visible on the posterior half of the dorsal plane, particularly on the right lateral side.
high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.dorsal_surface_indentations: The central dorsal ridge is visible as a vertical contrast line, but no significant traumatic depressions or blunt-force indentations are detected.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A series of at least three distinct, curved, parallel rake marks are visible on the posterior dorsal surface, oriented longitudinally.
